purpose: Recognize discounts, complimentary value, customer-facing service fees, and output taxes as distinct canonical financial facts without conflating provider charges or rewriting gross commercial truth.
invariants: discount plus complimentary value cannot exceed gross sales
declared customer collectible equals the governed formula
component source authority is tenant and organization scoped
provider fees remain governed by M4.6 and cannot be submitted as customer service fees
all component events, outbox messages, and journals commit or roll back together
replay is idempotent and conflicting reuse is rejected
gross commercial truth is preserved in immutable event metadata
